meaning: Only one frozen snapshot next-select/finish; no tree update/NN/backup/fullMCTS/counterfactualgame.

N=sumedgevisits required by contract. Original node.visits includes root evaluation (sumedge+1 in these roots); original select sqrt(node.visits+1) thus uses another unit. ContractN diagnostic is not actual original next selection.
Actual baseline select not logged, reference rootedges/PV and actualparentQ absent.
First candidate order and first replayed reference legal order are separate controlled factors.
Finish visits-only-first removes bothprior andseed from original; it is not labeled a one-factor contrast. Nested one-factor contrasts separately reported.
Score differences are arithmetic argmax diagnostics, not value improvement; near tie abs1e-6 defined before results.
No effect on finalsnapshot does not refute allH2; any changedargmax is not strength/adoption/NI evidence.
